blocks.text: Orttirma daraja (superlative) asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 90-dars): qisqa sifat — **the** + `-est`, uzun sifat — **the most**, noto'g'ri shakllar **the best / the worst / the furthest**, **in** va **of**, **one of the** ..., the best ... **I've ever** .... Imlo qoidalari qiyosiy darajadagidek (→ 105-dars). Bu darsda — chuqurroq qatlam: **the** qachon tushib qoladi, **in** / **of** tanlovining mantig'i, **one of the** dan keyingi fe'l, **by far** va **the second biggest**, **the least / the fewest**, ravishlarning orttirma darajasi va Past Perfect bilan **I'd ever**. O'zbekchada hammasi bitta «**eng**» so'zi bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun aynan shu atrofdagi tafsilotlarda xato ko'p.

Odatda orttirma daraja oldida **the** turadi: guruhda «eng ...»si bitta, demak u aniq. Lekin egalik so'zi (my, your, Tashkent's, the company's) bo'lsa, **the** qo'yilmaydi — ikkalasi birga kelmaydi: **my best** friend («my the best friend» emas), Tashkent's **biggest** park. Bitta narsa o'zining turli holatlari bilan taqqoslansa, **the** ko'pincha tushadi: The city is **most beautiful** in spring — shahar bahorda eng chiroyli (boshqa shaharlar bilan emas, o'zining boshqa fasllari bilan taqqoslanyapti). Adashtirmang: **most** + ot = «ko'pchilik» (**most** people — orttirma emas, → 88-dars); **a most** + sifat — rasmiy «juda»: a **most** interesting talk.

rows: eng yaqin do'stim, Toshkentning eng katta bog'i
The city is **most beautiful** in spring.
**Most** people work from nine to six.

items.text: My **best** friend lives in Fergana, so we mostly talk online.
items.translation: **Eng yaqin** do'stim Farg'onada yashaydi, shuning uchun asosan onlayn gaplashamiz.

items.text: Tashkent's **biggest** park is full of families at the weekend.
items.translation: Toshkentning **eng katta** bog'i dam olish kunlari oilalar bilan to'la bo'ladi.

items.text: The sea is **warmest** in August, so book your holiday then.
items.translation: Dengiz avgustda **eng iliq** bo'ladi, shuning uchun ta'tilni o'sha paytga band qiling.

blocks.text: **in** — joy yoki bir butun deb qaraladigan guruh bilan: **in** the world, **in** the city, **in** the company, **in** the team, **in** my family, **in** the class. **of** — vaqt davri yoki sanab o'tiladigan to'plam bilan: **of** the year, **of** my life, **of** the week, **of** all, **of** the three, **of** my friends, **of** all the hotels. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha `-dagi` yoki «... orasida» bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun bunday sinab ko'ring: «**...da**, **...ning ichida**» (joy, tashkilot) → **in**; «**...ning**, **... orasida**» (davr, ro'yxat) → **of**. «the best of the world» — xato, **in** the world.

rows: the most popular app **in** the country

items.text: She's the best surgeon **in** the hospital, so you're in good hands.
items.translation: U **shifoxonadagi** eng yaxshi jarroh, shuning uchun siz ishonchli qo'lda.

items.text: That was the coldest night **of** the winter.
Jasur is the tallest **of** my friends, so he always sits at the back.
items.translation: Jasur **do'stlarim orasida** eng baland bo'yli, shuning uchun doim orqada o'tiradi.

blocks.text: one of the ..., by far, the second ...

**one of the** + orttirma + **ko'plik ot** — «eng ...lardan biri» (→ qizil kitob, 90-dars). Yangi nozik joy — fe'l: ega **one** (bitta), shuning uchun fe'l birlikda: **One of the** biggest problems **is** traffic («are» emas). Farqni kuchaytirish uchun **by far** (beqiyos, boshqalardan ancha oldinda) va **easily** (shubhasiz) ishlatiladi: **by far the** best, **easily the** most popular. **much** orttirma bilan ishlatilmaydi — u qiyosiy uchun (→ 106-dars). Tartib raqami bilan: **the second** largest city — kattaligi bo'yicha ikkinchi shahar, **the third** most popular — mashhurligi bo'yicha uchinchi.
the best ... I've ever ... va I'd ever ...

Orttirma daraja + Present Perfect + **ever** — «shu paytgacha ko'rganlarim ichida eng ...» (→ 8-dars). Agar o'tmishdagi voqea haqida hikoya qilsangiz, tajriba o'sha paytgacha bo'ladi, shuning uchun Past Perfect keladi (→ 15-dars): It **was** the best meal **I'd ever had**. **ever** ot va fe'lsiz ham keladi: the best film **ever**, the hottest day **ever recorded**. O'zbekchada bularning hammasi sifatdosh bilan: men **yegan**, biz **ko'rgan**, **qayd etilgan** eng ....

items.text: This is **the strongest** coffee **I've ever had** — I won't sleep tonight!
items.translation: Bu men **ichgan eng quyuq** qahva — bu kecha uxlay olmayman!

items.text: It was **the most boring** film **I'd ever seen**, so I left early.
items.translation: Bu men **ko'rgan eng zerikarli** film edi, shuning uchun erta chiqib ketdim.

items.text: Scientists say last summer was **the hottest ever recorded** in Europe.
items.translation: Olimlarning aytishicha, o'tgan yoz Yevropada **qayd etilgan eng issiq** yoz bo'ldi.

blocks.text: the least, the fewest va ravishlar

**the least** — **the most** ning teskarisi: **the least** expensive (eng arzon, eng kam xarajatli), **the least** popular (eng kam ommabop); sanalmaydigan ot bilan: **the least** time. Ko'plik ot bilan esa **the fewest**: **the fewest** mistakes (105-darsdagi less / fewer farqi bu yerda ham). Ravishlar ham orttirma darajaga ega: run **the fastest**, work **the hardest**, explain **the most clearly**; ravish bilan **the** so'zlashuvda tushib qolishi mumkin: Who runs **fastest**? **the most** yolg'iz ham keladi: Who earns **the most**? What I like **most** is ...

items.text: Go shopping early in the morning — it's **the least** busy time.
items.translation: Xaridga erta tongda boring — bu **eng kam** gavjum vaqt.

items.text: Of all the runners, Kate ran **the fastest** in the rain.
items.translation: Barcha yuguruvchilar ichida yomg'irda Keyt **eng tez** yugurdi.

items.text: The team with **the fewest** points will leave the league.
items.translation: **Eng kam** ochko to'plagan jamoa ligani tark etadi.

blocks.text: Faqat **ikkita** narsa taqqoslansa, an'anaviy qoida — qiyosiy daraja: **the taller of the two** brothers (ikki aka-ukaning bo'yi balandrog'i), **the cheaper** of the two options. So'zlashuvda «the tallest of the two» ham eshitiladi, lekin yozuvda va imtihonda qiyosiyni tanlang. Uch va undan ko'p bo'lsa — orttirma: **the tallest of the three**.
Turg'un iboralar: at least, at the latest

rows: We can spend **at most** fifty pounds.
Send it by Friday **at the latest**.
The flat will be ready in May **at the earliest**.
**At best**, the repairs will take a week.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «my the best friend», «the my best friend» → **my best friend**; «One of the biggest problems are ...» → ... **is** ...; «one of the best restaurant» → one of the best **restaurants**; «the best of the world» → **in** the world; «the less expensive» («eng» ma'nosida) → **the least** expensive; «the least mistakes» → **the fewest** mistakes; «the most of people» → **most people**; «the second most big» → **the second biggest**; «much the best» → **by far the best**; o'tmish haqida hikoyada «It was the best day I've ever had» → **I'd ever had**.

«eng» ko'rsangiz, uch savol bering: (1) oldida «mening», «Toshkentning» bormi? — bo'lsa, **the** yo'q; (2) joymi yoki davr / ro'yxatmi? — joy → **in**, davr / ro'yxat → **of**; (3) «...lardan biri»mi? — **one of the** + ko'plik ot + birlik fe'l (is / was).
Bog'lanish: qiyosiy daraja va less / fewer — 105-dars; much / far + qiyosiy — 106-dars; as ... as, than — 107-dars; Present Perfect + ever — 8-dars; Past Perfect — 15-dars; most / most of — 88-dars.

rows: the best **in** the team / the best day **of** my life
**one of the** + ko'plik ot + birlik fe'l
the best meal **I've ever had** / **I'd ever had**

examples.title: **the busiest**, **the most reliable**: everyday use
examples.description: Orttirma daraja kundalik vaziyatlarda: `-est`, **the most**, ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar va egalik so'zidan keyin **the** siz shakl.

sentences.text: Friday evening is **the busiest** time at our restaurant.
sentences.translation: Juma oqshomi restoranimizda **eng gavjum** payt.

sentences.text: Which is **the most reliable** way to send money abroad?
sentences.translation: Chet elga pul jo'natishning **eng ishonchli** yo'li qaysi?

sentences.text: Moving to a new city was **the most stressful** thing I did last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili qilgan ishlarim ichida **eng ko'p stress bergani** yangi shaharga ko'chish bo'ldi.

sentences.text: We chose **the quietest** room in the hotel because Jasur sleeps badly.
sentences.translation: Jasur yomon uxlagani uchun mehmonxonadagi **eng sokin** xonani tanladik.

sentences.text: Our **cheapest** option is the night bus, but it takes twelve hours.
sentences.translation: Bizning **eng arzon** variantimiz — tungi avtobus, lekin u o'n ikki soat yuradi.

sentences.text: **The most common** mistake in job interviews is talking too much.
sentences.translation: Ish suhbatlaridagi **eng keng tarqalgan** xato — ortiqcha gapirish.

sentences.text: Who is **the most experienced** surgeon in this hospital?
sentences.translation: Bu shifoxonadagi **eng tajribali** jarroh kim?

sentences.text: July is usually **the driest** month in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda iyul odatda **eng quruq** oy bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Emma bought **the simplest** phone in the shop because she only needs it for calls.
sentences.translation: Emma do'kondagi **eng oddiy** telefonni sotib oldi, chunki unga faqat qo'ng'iroq uchun kerak.

sentences.text: That was **the worst** traffic jam we've had since the bridge closed.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik yopilgandan beri bu **eng yomon** tirbandlik bo'ldi.

examples.title: **in** the team, **of** the year
examples.description: **in** — joy va tashkilot (in the city, in the company); **of** — davr va to'plam (of the year, of all, of four sisters).

sentences.text: Bekzod is the fastest runner **in** our school.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **maktabimizdagi** eng tez yuguruvchi.

sentences.text: December 21st is the shortest day **of** the year.
sentences.translation: 21-dekabr — **yilning** eng qisqa kuni.

sentences.text: This is the oldest mosque **in** the city, and it's still in use.
sentences.translation: Bu **shahardagi** eng qadimiy masjid, u hali ham faoliyat yuritadi.

sentences.text: **Of** all the cities we visited, Edinburgh was the most beautiful.
sentences.translation: Biz borgan **shaharlar orasida** Edinburg eng chiroylisi edi.

sentences.text: Madina is the youngest **of** four sisters, and she's the most spoilt.
sentences.translation: Madina **to'rt opa-singilning** eng kichigi, eng erkasi ham u.

sentences.text: Who is the best goalkeeper **in** the league this season?
sentences.translation: Bu mavsum **ligadagi** eng yaxshi darvozabon kim?

sentences.text: My wedding day was the happiest day **of** my life.
sentences.translation: To'yim kuni **hayotimdagi** eng baxtli kun bo'ldi.

sentences.text: It's the most popular delivery app **in** Uzbekistan at the moment.
sentences.translation: Hozir bu **O'zbekistondagi** eng mashhur yetkazib berish ilovasi.

sentences.text: **Of** the three candidates, Nilufar had the most impressive CV.
sentences.translation: Uch nomzod **orasida** Nilufarning rezyumesi eng ta'sirli edi.

sentences.text: Our manager is the hardest-working person **in** the whole company.
sentences.translation: Rahbarimiz **butun kompaniyadagi** eng mehnatkash odam.

examples.title: **one of the** + superlative + plural noun
examples.description: «eng ...lardan biri»: **one of the** + orttirma + ko'plik ot. Ega bo'lsa, fe'l birlikda (One of the ... **is**).

sentences.text: Bukhara is **one of the best-preserved** old cities in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Buxoro Markaziy Osiyodagi **eng yaxshi saqlangan** qadimiy **shaharlardan biri**.

sentences.text: **One of the biggest problems** in our office **is** the slow internet.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizdagi **eng katta muammolardan biri** — sekin internet.

sentences.text: Plov is **one of the most famous dishes** in Uzbek cuisine.
sentences.translation: Palov o'zbek oshxonasining **eng mashhur taomlaridan biri**.

sentences.text: Oliver is **one of the most talented designers** I've worked with.
sentences.translation: Oliver men birga ishlagan **eng iqtidorli dizaynerlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Getting enough sleep is **one of the easiest ways** to stay healthy.
sentences.translation: Yetarlicha uxlash sog'lom bo'lishning **eng oson yo'llaridan biri**.

sentences.text: Was it **one of the hardest decisions** you've ever made?
sentences.translation: Bu siz qabul qilgan **eng qiyin qarorlardan biri** bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Heathrow is **one of the busiest airports** in the world.
sentences.translation: Xitrou dunyodagi **eng gavjum aeroportlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Climate change is **one of the most serious challenges** facing our planet.
sentences.translation: Iqlim o'zgarishi sayyoramiz oldida turgan **eng jiddiy muammolardan biri**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's bakery has become **one of the most popular places** in the neighbourhood.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning nonvoyxonasi mahalladagi **eng mashhur joylardan biriga** aylandi.

sentences.text: Learning to drive was **one of the best things** I did after university.
sentences.translation: Haydashni o'rganish universitetdan keyin qilgan **eng yaxshi ishlarimdan biri** bo'ldi.

examples.title: **the best** ... **I've ever** ... / **I'd ever** ...
examples.description: Orttirma + Present Perfect + **ever** (hozirgacha); o'tmishdagi hikoyada — Past Perfect (**I'd ever**); **ever recorded**.

sentences.text: Honestly, this is **the most delicious** lagman **I've ever eaten** in a café.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, bu men kafeda **yegan eng mazali** lag'mon.

sentences.text: It was **the longest** flight **I'd ever taken**, and I couldn't sleep at all.
sentences.translation: Bu men **uchgan eng uzoq** parvoz edi, umuman uxlay olmadim.

sentences.text: What's **the most interesting** place **you've ever visited**?
sentences.translation: Siz **borgan eng qiziqarli** joy qayer?

sentences.text: Kate said it was **the worst** hotel she **had ever stayed** in.
sentences.translation: Keyt bu u **to'xtagan eng yomon** mehmonxona bo'lganini aytdi.

sentences.text: That's **the best** advice anyone **has ever given** me.
sentences.translation: Bu menga kimdir **bergan eng yaxshi** maslahat.

sentences.text: Last night's storm was **the strongest** the city **had ever seen**.
sentences.translation: Kechagi bo'ron shahar **ko'rgan eng kuchli** bo'ron edi.

sentences.text: Aziz's mother is **the kindest** woman **I've ever known**.
sentences.translation: Azizning onasi men **tanigan eng mehribon** ayol.

sentences.text: Was that **the hardest** exam **you've ever taken**?
sentences.translation: Bu siz **topshirgan eng qiyin** imtihon bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Yesterday was **the hottest** October day **ever recorded** in London.
sentences.translation: Kecha Londonda **qayd etilgan eng issiq** oktyabr kuni bo'ldi.

sentences.text: For Jasur, it was **the most exciting** match he **had ever played** in.
sentences.translation: Jasur uchun bu u **o'ynagan eng hayajonli** o'yin edi.

examples.title: **by far the best**, **the second largest**
examples.description: Kuchaytirish: **by far** (beqiyos), **easily** (shubhasiz); tartib raqami bilan: **the second / third** + orttirma.

sentences.text: Tashkent is **by far the largest** city in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Toshkent O'zbekistondagi **beqiyos eng katta** shahar.

sentences.text: Birmingham is **the second largest** city in the UK.
sentences.translation: Birmingem Buyuk Britaniyadagi **kattaligi bo'yicha ikkinchi** shahar.

sentences.text: This café is **easily the best** place in town for breakfast.
sentences.translation: Bu kafe **shubhasiz** shahardagi nonushta uchun **eng yaxshi** joy.

sentences.text: August was **by far the busiest** month for our travel agency.
sentences.translation: Avgust sayyohlik agentligimiz uchun **beqiyos eng gavjum** oy bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Nilufar got **the third highest** score in the national exam.
sentences.translation: Nilufar milliy imtihonda **uchinchi eng yuqori** ballni oldi.

sentences.text: Which is **the second most popular** language on the internet?
sentences.translation: Internetda **mashhurligi bo'yicha ikkinchi** til qaysi?

sentences.text: Oliver is **easily the most reliable** person on the team.
sentences.translation: Oliver **shubhasiz** jamoadagi **eng ishonchli** odam.

sentences.text: Rent is **by far the biggest** expense for most students in London.
sentences.translation: Londondagi ko'pchilik talabalar uchun ijara **beqiyos eng katta** xarajat.

sentences.text: The new hospital will be **the second biggest** in the region.
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxona viloyatda **kattaligi bo'yicha ikkinchi** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Of all the apps I use, this one is **by far the most useful**.
sentences.translation: Men ishlatadigan barcha ilovalar ichida bunisi **beqiyos eng foydali**.

examples.title: **the least**, **the fewest**, **the fastest** (adverbs)
examples.description: **the least** + sifat yoki sanalmaydigan ot, **the fewest** + ko'plik ot; ravishlarning orttirma darajasi; **the most** yolg'iz.

sentences.text: This is **the least expensive** way to get to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Bu Xivaga borishning **eng arzon** yo'li.

sentences.text: Which of these laptops uses **the least** power?
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuklardan qaysi biri **eng kam** quvvat sarflaydi?

sentences.text: Bekzod made **the fewest** mistakes in the whole group.
sentences.translation: Bekzod butun guruhda **eng kam** xato qildi.

sentences.text: Who works **the hardest** in your family, in your opinion?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, oilangizda kim **eng ko'p** mehnat qiladi?

sentences.text: Of all my colleagues, Sarah explains things **the most clearly**.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarim orasida Sara narsalarni **eng tushunarli** qilib tushuntiradi.

sentences.text: The **least popular** course this year was ancient history.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi **eng kam ommabop** kurs qadimgi tarix bo'ldi.

sentences.text: What I enjoy **most** about my job is meeting new people.
sentences.translation: Ishimda menga **eng ko'p** yoqadigan narsa — yangi odamlar bilan tanishish.

sentences.text: Jasur arrived **the earliest**, so he got the best seat.
sentences.translation: Jasur **eng erta** keldi, shuning uchun eng yaxshi joyni egalladi.

sentences.text: The city is **most beautiful** in April, when the trees are in blossom.
sentences.translation: Shahar aprelda, daraxtlar gullaganda, **eng chiroyli** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Which member of the team earns **the most**, do you think?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, jamoaning qaysi a'zosi **eng ko'p** maosh oladi?

examples.title: Two or more? **the taller of the two** / **the tallest**
examples.description: Ikkita narsa — qiyosiy (**the cheaper of the two**), uch va undan ko'p — orttirma (**the tallest of all**). Ikkalasi bir gapda.

sentences.text: Of the two hotels, the second one was **the cheaper**.
sentences.translation: Ikki mehmonxonadan ikkinchisi **arzonrog'i** edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza is **the taller of the two** sisters.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ikki opa-singilning **bo'yi balandrog'i**.

sentences.text: Aziz is **the youngest** of five brothers.
sentences.translation: Aziz besh aka-ukaning **eng kichigi**.

sentences.text: We received two offers and accepted **the safer** one.
sentences.translation: Ikkita taklif oldik va **xavfsizrog'ini** qabul qildik.

sentences.text: Our flat is **bigger than** our neighbours', but theirs is **the brightest** in the building.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz qo'shnilarnikidan **kattaroq**, lekin ularniki binodagi **eng yorug'i**.

sentences.text: Is the train **faster than** the bus, or is the plane **the fastest** option?
sentences.translation: Poyezd avtobusdan **tezroq**mi yoki **eng tez** variant samolyotmi?

sentences.text: Of the twins, James is definitely **the more talkative**.
sentences.translation: Egizaklardan, shubhasiz, Jeyms **gapdonrog'i**.

sentences.text: Emma got a **better** mark **than** me, but Tom got **the best** mark in the class.
sentences.translation: Emma mendan **yaxshiroq** baho oldi, lekin sinfdagi **eng yaxshi** bahoni Tom oldi.

sentences.text: Nilufar's presentation was **the clearest**, and Kate's was **the most creative**.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning taqdimoti **eng aniq**, Keytniki esa **eng ijodiy** edi.

sentences.text: This laptop is **lighter than** that one, but the third is **the lightest** of all.
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk anavinisidan **yengilroq**, lekin uchinchisi hammasidan **eng yengil**.

examples.title: Dialogue: the best trip ever
examples.description: Ikki do'st sayohat haqida gaplashadi: **the most beautiful ... I've ever seen**, **by far the longest**, **one of the most unusual**, **the fewest**.

sentences.text: — Welcome back, Madina! How was the trip? Was Khiva **the best** part?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsan, Madina! Sayohat qalay o'tdi? **Eng yaxshi** qismi Xiva bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: — Definitely! It's **the most beautiful** town **I've ever seen**.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! Bu men **ko'rgan eng go'zal** shahar.

sentences.text: — Better than Bukhara? Most people say Bukhara is **the most impressive**.
sentences.translation: — Buxorodan ham yaxshimi? Ko'pchilik Buxoroni **eng ta'sirli** deydi.

sentences.text: — Bukhara was lovely, but Khiva felt like **the oldest** place on earth.
sentences.translation: — Buxoro ajoyib edi, lekin Xiva yer yuzidagi **eng qadimiy** joydek tuyuldi.

sentences.text: — And what was **the hardest** part of the journey?
sentences.translation: — Safarning **eng og'ir** qismi nima bo'ldi?

sentences.text: — The train from Tashkent — it was **by far the longest** ride of my life.
sentences.translation: — Toshkentdan poyezd — hayotimdagi **beqiyos eng uzoq** yo'l bo'ldi.

sentences.text: — Did you try shivit oshi? It's **one of the most unusual** dishes in the country.
sentences.translation: — Shivit oshini tatib ko'rdingmi? U mamlakatdagi **eng g'ayrioddiy taomlardan biri**.

sentences.text: — Yes! It was **the greenest** plov **I'd ever eaten**, and very tasty.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Bu men **yegan eng yashil** osh edi, juda mazali ham.

sentences.text: — Which month is **the best** for a visit, in your opinion?
sentences.translation: — Sening fikringcha, borish uchun **eng yaxshi** oy qaysi?

sentences.text: — Late April: the weather is **the most pleasant**, and there are **the fewest** tourists.
sentences.translation: — Aprel oxiri: havo **eng yoqimli**, sayyohlar esa **eng kam** bo'ladi.
